ns2:section.sectionText: Description: This seminar concludes the two-part sequence for first year History graduate students that began in HIST 593. HIST 594 guides students in the writing of an original piece of historical scholarship while introducing them to disciplinary issues in the field. Thus, while working to craft a research paper of article length (c. 10,000 words), our course will also examine such issues as: identifying and utilizing traditional and nontraditional sources, developing a research problem, crafting an extended interpretive argument, finding your authorial voice, formulating research and writing strategies, determining the role of theory, intervening in the historiography, identifying publication venues, and communicating findings across disciplinary fields.
